taxonomy_note: Compatibility planning lens only, not a normative cross-domain mapping. Final root-cause taxonomy may differ or remain unassigned.
native_context: Amazon S3 bucket/object/access-point authorization and public-access controls

controls.boundary: Amazon S3 object access and publication boundaries — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Read bucket/access-point/object policies, public-access controls, ownership/ACL settings and the signed-URL issuer where relevant. Establish exact object sensitivity and caller identity.
controls.controlled_verification: On an owned bucket with synthetic objects, compare the expected recipient with a prohibited anonymous/other-account read or write only as permitted. For signed URLs, trace who may mint a URL for which object/action and its lifetime; do not list or download unrelated bucket contents.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A public website object can be intentionally readable. A public-looking policy may be constrained by effective controls. A valid recipient using an intended signed URL is not proof of excess authority.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Repair the effective bucket/object or URL-issuer boundary and preserve required publishing. Retest the exact denied tuple and intended owner/recipient access, including relevant access points.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
